 Kristen N:
 The snow crab leg bucket was amazing! It was delicious, they were cooked perfectly, & the potatoes, corn, & butter topped it all off. We left full & happy. The service was good, we had a party of 9 & she did a great job. We will definitely eat there again & recommend others to go there.Review by - Googlefive star review by
 Yuliia M:
 My experience was amazing! I have been here multiple times before. Crab legs, crabcakes (homemade), and peel-n-eat shrimp are my favorite dishes. The restaurant is clean and the service is excellent! Great spot for seafood lovers!Review by - Googlefive star review by
 Coty H:
 My fiance ordered the scallops grilled said they were the best she ever had. I had ordered the gator bites as a meal so delicious I will most definitely be back also the location and parking can't beat it because you're on the beach. Also If that parking lot is full go directly across the street ! Great service and food thank you !Review by - Googlefive star review by
